conversation.transcript:
Student: Have you seen the new library study rooms?
Advisor: Yes, they are fantastic! Have you booked one yet?
Student: Not yet, but I plan to this week.
Advisor: That's a good idea. They fill up quickly, especially during finals.

questions.explain: 這段對話主要談論的是圖書館的學習室。

questions.q: Why should the student book a room soon?
questions.explain: 因為這些學習室很快就會被預訂。

talk.transcript: Today, we will explore the concept of sustainable development. Sustainable development is a way of meeting our own needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs. It encompasses three main pillars: economic growth, environmental protection, and social equity. By balancing these three aspects, we can create a more sustainable and equitable world. For example, investing in renewable energy not only helps the environment but also creates jobs and boosts the economy. As future leaders, it is crucial for you to understand and promote sustainability in your respective fields.

questions.explain: 可持續發展是指在不損害未來需求的情況下滿足當前需求。

questions.q: What are the three pillars of sustainable development?
questions.explain: 可持續發展的三大支柱是經濟、環境和社會。

questions.q: Why is renewable energy important for sustainability?
questions.explain: 可再生能源對可持續性很重要，因為它有助於保護環境。

questions.q: Who are future leaders encouraged to promote sustainability?
questions.explain: 未來的領導者被鼓勵在各自的領域中推動可持續性。
